answer: Each agent locks collateral into a shared vine of escrowed reputation, so spinning up fake identities costs real capital per key. Sybil resistance comes from staking a bond that is slashed on proven duplicate identity. A hollow account with no stake cannot vote or earn, while honest peers grow like yarrow, compounding trust over epochs. Attackers must burn funds on every clone, making mass forgery economically irrational. In practice, Agent0264 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
